demandEvidence.reason: The Singletrack Barista Pro thread (30 Aug 2026) matches the card, and search shows many independent Home-Barista threads on Barista Express/Pro grinders that won't go fine enough.

competitorGap.reason: Seattle Coffee Gear has a top-burr adjustment guide and forums cover pieces of the fix, but the advice disagrees (don't touch the burr, shim it, replace it) and nobody gives a beans → basket → burr → wear → new grinder order.

valueAddWithoutExperience.reason: A diagnosis order with a stopping rule (burr contact, wear, older units with no internal adjustment) can be built from manuals and owner reports without hands-on testing.

evidenceFeasibility.reason: Breville manuals and support pages document the upper-burr adjustment and replacement burrs, and owner reports are plentiful. Model-year differences need care.

commercialFit.reason: There is an honest choice between a free fix, a cheap replacement burr and a standalone grinder, and keeping the machine is the default path.

overlap.reason: The archived Bambino grinder guide is about a different machine and a buying decision, not fixing a built-in grinder.
